slides.texte_overlay:
Weekend habits of men
who never fall behind

1. They wake up at
the same time

Saturday isn't a reason
to lose the morning.

2. They move outside

A run, a hike, a game.
Fresh air resets the week.

3. They see people

Friends, family, a long lunch.
No screens at the table.

4. They prep the week

Groceries, laundry, a plan.
Monday starts calm.

5. They learn something new

A short lesson, a chapter,
a new idea for the week.

Use a micro-learning app
